options.name: bridge
options.description: Name of bridge or fake bridge to manage

options.name: database_socket
options.description: Path/ip to datbase socket to use Default path is used if not specified Path should start with 'unix:' prefix

options.name: external_ids
options.description: A dictionary of external-ids. Omitting this parameter is a No-op. To  clear all external-ids pass an empty value.

options.name: fail_mode
options.description: Set bridge fail-mode. The default value (None) is a No-op.

options.name: parent
options.description: Bridge parent of the fake bridge to manage

options.name: set
options.description: Run set command after bridge configuration. This parameter is non-idempotent, play will always return I(changed) state if present. Accepts a string or a list of strings to chain multiple set sub-commands.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for ovs-vswitchd to respond

options.name: vlan
options.description: The VLAN id of the fake bridge to manage (must be between 0 and 4095). This parameter is required if I(parent) parameter is set.
